summary: Suspicious SSO token reuse after calendar .ics invite with redirect link
description: Issue summary: Several employees reported being prompted to reauthorize SSO after opening a calendar invitation (.ics) that contained an HTML redirect. Impact: Possible session token exposure or replay for small set of users; no confirmed lateral movement. Environment: prod SSO for Google Workspace and internal SSO proxy (us-west). Steps to reproduce: 1) Receive calendar invite with embedded URL in DESCRIPTION. 2) Clicked link from macOS Mail or Google Calendar. 3) User redirected to SSO login/reauth flow. 4) Some sessions invalidated and new sessions created. Logs: See audit log entries linked below; suspicious redirect chain observed in proxy logs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open received .ics/caldav invite in default mail/calendar app. 2) Click embedded DESCRIPTION link. 3) Observe redirect to internal SSO endpoint and reauth prompt. 4) Check /session/create and /session/invalidate audit events in proxy logs.
initial_hypothesis: Calendar invite contained an HTML redirect or URL shortener that caused browser to re-request SSO cookies; potential malicious actor tricked users into initiating auth flows leading to session reuse or token replay.
investigation_notes: 03-13 09:22 - Marcus: Pulled proxy logs for urls associated with suspicious invite tokens; found same IP 35.214.10.9 hitting /sso/callback for 6 distinct users within 90s.
03-13 11:10 - Security: No evidence of privilege escalation; tokens exchanged appear to be short-lived. Session creation events show new session IDs but originating IPs match user IPs.
03-13 12:05 - Engineering: Verified calendar gateway sanitized DESCRIPTION field for incoming invites three months ago — but ICS attachments bypassed sanitizer when rendered by macOS Mail.
03-13 14:30 - Forensics: Extracted ICS payload; contains redirect to tiny[.]link/rdw1 which resolves to compromised marketing site with meta-refresh to SSO endpoint.
03-13 16:00 - SRE: Rate of failed MFA prompts spiked 03-13 08:45-09:15 for three users; correlate with calendar invite delivery timestamps.

resolution: Mitigation: Blocked redirect domain via web-proxy and email quarantine; applied ICS rendering patch to email gateway to strip external HTML meta-refresh/redirects; rolled out provider-level calendar invite sanitization rule. Follow-up: 1) Rotate SSO session signing keys scheduled 2026-03-16 as precaution. 2) Update runbook to include ICS-specific checks. 3) Notify Finance to check for similar invites to vendor list. Post-incident review assigned to Dina Lopez and Marcus Nguyen due 2026-03-20.
